name: Invidious
short_description: Ad-free, privacy-respecting alternative frontend for YouTube.
description: Invidious is an open-source, lightweight alternative front-end to YouTube. It allows you to search, watch, and subscribe to YouTube videos and channels completely ad-free and without Google tracking you. You can create playlists, manage subscriptions, and listen to audio in the background without needing a Google account. The self-hosted version includes a PostgreSQL database to save your local preferences and subscriptions.
usecases: Watch YouTube videos without advertisements or algorithmic tracking.
Subscribe to YouTube channels via RSS without needing a Google account.
Listen to video audio in the background on mobile devices.
Bypass region locks and age restrictions natively through the proxy.
notes: Includes the Invidious Companion service to improve stream stability and reduce blocking.
